Install t3code-patched on Omarchy

Open-source control plane for coding agents, with Omarchy environment-theme patches

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add t3code-patched-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.0.35-5:
    pacman -Qi t3code-patched-bin

Open and use t3code-patched

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql t3code-patched-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install t3code-patched on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add t3code-patched-bin. The download is 149.2 MB and it takes 498.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is t3code-patched free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall t3code-patched?

Run omarchy pkg drop t3code-patched-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does t3code-patched depend on?

The package declares 26 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, cairo, dbus, expat, gcc-libs, glib2, glibc, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libcups, libnotify and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is t3code-patched in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as t3code-patched-bin (version 0.0.35-5) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://t3.codes. This site is unofficial: an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Omacom or David Heinemeier Hansson. Built with David's blessing.
